newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - BTPs topping, to head down to 135.00.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - BTPs topping, to head down to 135.00.

text.p: September BTP futures are beginning to look soggy and technical analysts said on Tuesday losses to at least 135.00 were on the cards in the short-term.
"Upside risk is very limited and the best thing we can hope for is a consolidation around the current trend," said Bob Emanuels, vice-president at ABN-AMRO Hoare Govett in Amsterdam.

Emanuels said a break below the 136.00/135.90 area would see an acceleration to the downside. Until 136.20, which was now a key level on the 10-minute chart, was taken out, the risk would be on the downside.
By 0750, September BTP was 0.21 down on the day at 136.08.
Emanuels said the uptrend was in the process of breaking right now.
"But in the medium term it doesn't mean that we have to go down. I would rather expect a slowdown of the trend," he said.
A steep uptrend in Italian bonds since mid-June pushed the September contract up to a peak on Monday at 137.10 where the rally faltered.
Emanuels said the daily chart looked like forming a double top at 137.05 and 137.10.
Ian Stannard, technical analyst at Chase in London said BTPs had broken through the up trendline, signalling losses.
